checks.criterion: AC1: Failing-first m-chi tests and independent Jones-vector oracle.

checks.criterion: AC2: Required transmit ellipticity, recorded handedness and F6 synthesis.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:2214-2228 rejects undeclared ellipticities; :2343-2349 requires chi_tx; :2407-2421 records handedness. Independent Jones derivation gives F6 (S1,S4)=(0.74,-0.24) for -45 degrees and (0.34,0.16) for +45 degrees, consistent with tests at test_polarimetry_mchi.py:241-285 and PRD tolerances. Runtime validation was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC3: m and chi formulas, unpolarized identity, nonpositive S1 and nonphysical Stokes.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:2494-2536 implements scaled polarized norm, m, sin(2chi), validity rules and M_ZERO without publishing a valid zero ellipticity. Tests at test_polarimetry_mchi.py:713-859 cover unit m, the unpolarized 2x2 identity, S1 <= 0 and nonphysical inputs. Runtime validation was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC4: Unsupported m-chi decomposition remains deferred.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:2445-2452 contains m, sin_2chi, chi and metadata, with no decomposition powers; :2566-2569 explicitly documents the deferral. scripts/ralph/batches/t2-polarimetry/prd.json:261 lists the decomposition as deferred.

checks.criterion: AC5: Synthetic lunar sign check, strict majority and no silent sign flip.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:2672-2680 uses strictly more than half; :2778-2805 computes fractions without changing S4. test_polarimetry_mchi.py:1077-1124 asserts the 95% example, negated sign, unchanged input and majority boundaries. Runtime validation was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC6: Context role and no cross-band comparison.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:2231-2236 rejects roles other than context; HybridStokes and MChi default to context at :2293 and :2452. Inspection of all additions found no cross-band comparison or distance function.
